newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 scales new peaks on rate hopes, profits.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 scales new peaks on rate hopes, profits.

text.p: UK's FTSE 100 index of leading shares hit a new milestone on Wednesday as solid corporate results and a weaker pound drew buyers back into stocks, even as the Bank of England contemplated an interest rate hike.
The key share price index added 65.6 points to close at 5,026.2, passing the 5,000 level for the first time ever.
Advancers beat decliners by a margin of two-to-one.
Dealers and strategists said expectations the BoE would raise rates at the end of its two-day meeting tomorrow had diminished.
